passages.text: Vindicate me, O God, and plead my case against an ungodly nation; deliver me from deceitful and unjust men.
passages.sermon:
God, You are the judge.
Judge me, O God.
Defend my cause.
My enemies are an ungodly nation.
They do not show kindness.
Rescue me from people who lie.
Save me from people who do wrong.
passages.original: שָׁפְטֵ֤נִי אֱלֹהִ֨ים׀ וְרִ֘יבָ֤ה רִיבִ֗י מִגּ֥וֹי לֹא־ חָסִ֑יד מֵ֤אִישׁ־ מִרְמָ֖ה וְעַוְלָ֣ה תְפַלְּטֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: For You are the God of my refuge. Why have You rejected me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?
passages.sermon:
God is my refuge.
God protects me.
I feel rejected by God.
I ask God, “Why have You rejected me?”
I walk in sorrow.
The enemy oppresses me.
I ask God, “Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?”
passages.original: כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֤ה׀ אֱלֹהֵ֣י מָֽעוּזִּי֮ לָמָ֪ה זְנַ֫חְתָּ֥נִי לָֽמָּה־ קֹדֵ֥ר אֶתְהַלֵּ֗ךְ בְּלַ֣חַץ אוֹיֵֽב׃

passages.text: Send out Your light and Your truth; let them lead me. Let them bring me to Your holy mountain, and to the place where You dwell.
passages.sermon:
God, send out Your light.
God, send out Your truth.
Your light and Your truth will lead me.
Your light and Your truth will bring me to Your holy mountain.
Your light and Your truth will bring me to the place where You live.
passages.original: שְׁלַח־ אוֹרְךָ֣ וַ֭אֲמִתְּךָ הֵ֣מָּה יַנְח֑וּנִי יְבִיא֥וּנִי אֶל־ הַֽר־ קָ֝דְשְׁךָ֗ וְאֶל־ מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my greatest joy. I will praise You with the harp, O God, my God.
passages.sermon:
I will go to the altar of God.
God is my greatest joy.
I will praise You with the harp.
You are God, my God.
passages.original: וְאָב֤וֹאָה׀ אֶל־ מִזְבַּ֬ח אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֶל־ אֵל֮ שִׂמְחַ֪ת גִּ֫ילִ֥י וְאוֹדְךָ֥ בְכִנּ֗וֹר אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֱלֹהָֽי׃

passages.text: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
passages.sermon:
The psalmist speaks to his own soul.
He asks, "Why are you downcast, O my soul?"
He asks, "Why is there unease within me?"
He tells his soul, "Put your hope in God."
He says, "I will praise God again."
He calls God his Savior.
He calls God his God.
passages.original: מַה־ תִּשְׁתּ֬וֹחֲחִ֨י׀ נַפְשִׁי֮ וּֽמַה־ תֶּהֱמִ֪י עָ֫לָ֥י הוֹחִ֣ילִי לֵֽ֭אלֹהִים כִּי־ ע֣וֹד אוֹדֶ֑נּוּ יְשׁוּעֹ֥ת פָּ֝נַ֗י וֵֽאלֹהָֽי׃
